svg.title: DIA-206 · The plaque and the rack
svg.desc: An engraved plate of the wall inside a works entrance. High on the wall a polished brass plaque, fixed with four screws, is engraved FOR THE BENEFIT OF ALL. Below it hang a time clock and a time-card rack with nine pockets. Five pockets hold a card. Four are empty and drawn in rust, and the four pulled cards stand in a wire bin on the floor beneath. The plaque is the stated purpose. The rack is what was done.
svg.text: PART II · GOALS, ASSUMPTIONS, AND COORDINATION
nine thousand heads to about five thousand
Drawn to that count: nine slots, five cards.
DIA-206 · Read the purpose from the rack, not from the plaque.
